items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well, who did 2Bix play with? He was the same thing, different bands. He didn't have no particular band he was working with.

ctx.x: You don't remember any special particular bands? No, no, no, no, not any particular band he played with.

Well, who did 2Bix play with? He was the same thing, different bands. He didn't have no particular band he was working with. What did the 2Bix look like? Well, he was a little short fella, something like George. Kind of thin like George, too. Same color and all.
And what about Faso? What did he look like?
